name: @ai-km/service-retrieval
comment:sqlite-vec: sqlite-vec is pinned to an EXACT version, no `^` range. pnpm's auto-install-peers defaults to true and resolves even OPTIONAL peers, so a range here would let an install silently move the vector extension underneath a persisted index — a re-index event, not a patch bump. User decision 2026-09-02: upstream asg017/sqlite-vec 0.1.9 (the last stable; 0.1.10-alpha.4 deliberately not used).
